name: rbac-food-delivery
description: Monorepo for the food delivery platform (Angular + Node.js/Express + MongoDB, Version 1 modular monolith)

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace libs/shared-types && npm run build --workspace libs/shared-utils && npm run build --workspace libs/shared-validation

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
